summary: The assistant performed broad reconnaissance across the Gizmo monorepo: ripgrep searches for project/profile/extension APIs and a large number of file reads covering the agent server transport (websocket-server, server, load-extensions, pi-agent-service), extension packages (svelte, unity, git, activity, skill-authoring), project/registry tests, fake agent client, protocol schema tests, and app UI (ExtensionDialogs, Titlebar), plus config files (profiles.json, gizmo.extensions.json). All operations were read-only searches and inspections to understand current extension enablement, domain detection, and project/profile wiring before further changes.
